review_note: A Noetherian local henselian G-ring admits solutions approximating any formal polynomial solution modulo each m^N. Independently compared the prepared formulation with the pinned original theorem statement embedded in Stage A. No source proof/remarks opened; preliminary review only.
statement:
Let $R$ be a Noetherian local ring. Let
$f_1, \ldots, f_m \in R[x_1, \ldots, x_n]$.
Suppose that $(a_1, \ldots, a_n) \in (R^\wedge)^n$ is a solution
in $R^\wedge$. If $R$ is a henselian G-ring, then for every integer
$N$ there exists a solution $(b_1, \ldots, b_n) \in R^n$ in $R$ such that
$a_i - b_i \in \mathfrak m^NR^\wedge$.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{theorem-approximation-property}
Let $R$ be a Noetherian local ring. Let
$f_1, \ldots, f_m \in R[x_1, \ldots, x_n]$.
Suppose that $(a_1, \ldots, a_n) \in (R^\wedge)^n$ is a solution
in $R^\wedge$. If $R$ is a henselian G-ring, then for every integer
$N$ there exists a solution $(b_1, \ldots, b_n) \in R^n$ in $R$ such that
$a_i - b_i \in \mathfrak m^NR^\wedge$.
